_comment: Manual location overrides for institutions that cannot be auto-geocoded. Each affiliation_key must equal the ascii_key() of the affiliation string exactly as it appears in the eCOST export. Add new entries here when an institution remains on the pending list after a sync run. City-level coordinates are used when a precise campus location is unavailable.

overrides._note: IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca — small graduate school, may have thin OSM coverage. Via S. Micheletto 3, 55100 Lucca, Italy.
overrides.affiliation_key: imt school for advanced studies lucca
overrides.institution: IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca

overrides._note: University of Kragujevac — sub-unit suffix 'Faculty of Hotel Management and Tourism' prevents Nominatim from resolving the full affiliation string. Main university campus, Kragujevac, Serbia.
overrides.affiliation_key: university of kragujevac faculty of hotel management and tourism

overrides._note: IUSS Pavia — alternate eCOST string without the parenthetical. Same institution and coordinates as above.
